profile.name: Gal Jacobson
profile.headline: ‏Gal Jacobson‏ - ‏Houzz‏
profile.heroTagline: Designing and building resilient, high-throughput systems — clean architecture, reliable infrastructure, interfaces people enjoy using.
about: Senior Full-Stack Engineer building and scaling production web platforms end to end - Node.js, React, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL across AWS and GCP - owning features from architecture through deployment, reliability, and performance.
Fluent in modern AI-assisted engineering - building with Cursor agents, MCP integrations, and prompt engineering to ship faster while keeping high quality.

Proven record of leading complex features across distributed systems, collaborating with global cross-functional teams, and mentoring engineers - turning ambiguous requirements into pragmatic, high-quality products.

resume.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
overview: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with end-to-end ownership across backend services, APIs, frontend, and infrastructure - building and operating production systems in Python, Node.js, React, and GraphQL on AWS and GCP.
Takes complex features from system and API design through to production, with a focus on reliability, performance, and scalability via testing, observability (Grafana, Redash), and CI/CD automation.

Fluent in modern AI-assisted engineering - Cursor agents, MCP integrations, and prompt engineering - using AI/LLM tooling to improve developer productivity and speed delivery while keeping quality high.

experience.title: Full-Stack Engineer
bullets: Owned flagship Houzz Pro features end to end across backend services, GraphQL APIs, and a React frontend - Contracts, Credit Memos, and the Houzz Pro rebranding - from system design to production. Contracts alone is used by 4.8k companies on the top-tier plan.

Improved reliability, performance, and scalability of large-scale systems through observability (Grafana, Redash), testing, and CI/CD automation, and built workflow Automation across the documents suite.
Re-architected and upgraded services for scalability and maintainability, partnering with global cross-functional teams on system and API design.
